trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: Not until midnight I left the party.
trap.right: Not until midnight did I leave the party.
trap.why: Português mantém a ordem direta após “só quando/não até”; inglês inverte aux + sujeito após Not until.

mcq.q: Which sentence inverts correctly after Hardly?
opts: Hardly had she left when it rained.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a correct cleft about the plan?
opts: It was the plan that failed.
It was the plan what failed.

fix.right: Not until midnight did I leave.

fix.wrong: Hardly she had left when it rained.
fix.right: Hardly had she left when it rained.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “I did not leave until midnight.”
rewrite.answer: Not until midnight did I leave.
It was the plan that failed.

rewrite.prompt: Troque por convince: “He persuaded me that the plan was fair.”
rewrite.answer: He convinced me that the plan was fair.
